reason: Actual V022→V023 comparison: removing the BBQ-like roof was a substantial improvement in concept, but V023 shows a high disconnected chimney window above the fire, so smoke cannot plausibly enter from the hearth. Reference traditional side-draft forge chimney practice: smoke entrance begins level with or just above the fire. V024 opens the lower central rear masonry, replaces solid mortar core with side returns, builds a continuous soot-lined low duct behind the fire and shifts the tuyere to one side. Preserve V022/V023; no artistic approval.
